Affects the whole provider test surface and refines CROSS_AGENT_FINDINGS T1. The reported cause ('leaked sk_test_dummy credentials breaking config assertions' + 'ModuleNotFoundError for boto3 at infrastructure/storage/storage.py:27') is REFUTED on both counts. Evidence: (1) `grep sk_test_dummy backend/tests/providers -q > file` finds ZERO occurrences of sk_test_dummy in any of the 27337 lines of the full run's output - the assertion failures I saw on an isolated run (test_resolve_stripe_secret_key_empty asserting 'sk_test_dummy' == '') come from .env at the repo root (lines 52, 100, 102, 113: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, TAP_SECRET_KEY, TAP_API_BASE_URL, THAWANI_SECRET_KEY) leaking into os.environ, and they affect only the payments config assertions, not 1065 tests. (2) boto3 IS installed (python -c 'import boto3' -> 1.43.94) and the only 16 'boto3' mentions in the whole run are test NAMES and @patch targets, never a ModuleNotFoundError; backend/infrastructure/storage/storage.py:27 is `from providers.storage import create_s3_client`, not a boto3 import. The ACTUAL dominant cause is package shadowing: backend/tests/providers/__init__.py exists, and test_critical_tools.py:24 plus test_new_providers.py:19 do `sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))` which resolves to backend/tests/ - so `import providers` binds to backend/tests/providers (an empty test package with only __init__.py) instead of backend/providers. I proved it deterministically: inserting backend/tests at sys.path[0] flips providers.__path__ from ['...\backend\providers'] to ['...\backend\tests\providers'] and `import providers.comms` then raises exactly 'No module named providers.comms'. Order-dependent, which is why running any single file passes: `pytest tests/providers/test_providers.py -k has_twilio` -> 1 passed; adding test_critical_tools.py first -> 1 failed. 1176 of the 27337 output lines are 'No module named ...' errors, all of the form providers.<subpkg> (payments 209, image 201, geography 191, ai 113, voice 66, analytics 51, comms 50, security 33, config 27, finance 25, automation 24, auth 24, storage 21, ocr 19, bg_removal 17, _base 16, barcode 16, qr 15, shipping 13, async_workers 12, news 12, scanner 10, http 6, observability 5). Fix is one line in two files (insert backend/, not backend/tests/). Recorded as a coverage_gap, not a finding, since no packet record covers it.
